name: Spawn of Jubjub
label: Quest
description: Spawn of Jubjub: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I'm so happy Jubjub is no longer lost. She loves Dark Iron ale so much that when I ran out... She ran away to find more!
Now that Jubjub's back, I want as much ale as I can get! I won't want her to run away again!
Do you have any Dark Iron Ale? If you do, then I'll trade you one of Jubjub's frog eggs for a mug...

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you, friend. Here is your egg! It won't be ready to hatch for a little while, but when it does you'll have a great pet!
